name: ZONOS3-Mini
purpose: Zyphra's compact open-source text-to-speech model with natural speech and voice cloning; runs on phones, laptops and in the browser (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card metadata: apache-2.0; no LICENSE file in the HF repo and none found in the zonos2.cpp GitHub repo root. Canonical Apache-2.0 text read in the Qwen repo (canonical Apache-2.0 text read in https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-ASR/blob/main/LICENSE); the per-repo declaration, not a repo file, is the evidence.

architecture.kind: AUTOREGRESSIVE latent-MoE LM over 15 Hz dual-codec frames (ZAC 1, 44.1 kHz, 10 codebooks) with iSTFT head; about 100M active, so memory-bound in theory but launch-bound in practice
architecture.recurrent: Gated DeltaNet (9 of 11 layers) + 2 global attention

engine_support.notes: The card lists llama.cpp as an engine; not verified here

benchmarks.name: Median time to first audio, 8 concurrent, H100

strengths: 43 languages incl. German, 27 default voices, cloning from 5-10 s, voice design
Tiny active size, real time on laptops (vendor)
weaknesses: Text normalization only for 9 languages (German is one)
No WER or similarity numbers on the card (blog only)
Ten days old at check time: no user reports

user_reports.summary: Apostrophes are not read; Urdu listed as supported but not working (both open, 5 comments each).

tona_fit.reason: Apache-2.0, 0.8B, German officially listed with NeMo text normalisation, fits every class; runs via zonos2.cpp on CPU/Vulkan. No independent German numbers; two weeks old. Low value for coding agents.

open_questions: Own RTF on Zen 5 and gfx1200 Vulkan
